d: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

The MENA PR & Communications team is responsible for driving Binance’s regional communications strategy, strengthening brand reputation and supporting media relations, influencer engagement and strategic communications initiatives across the Middle East, North Africa, Pakistan and Turkey. Working closely with regional leadership, local market teams, external PR agencies and cross-functional stakeholders, the team delivers integrated communications campaigns, thought leadership initiatives, media engagements and high-profile industry events.

We are looking for a proactive, organized and enthusiastic Regional PR & Communications individual to join our MENA team for a six-month opportunity. The role will provide hands-on exposure to regional public relations, influencer marketing, media relations, events and communications operations across multiple markets. Working directly with the Regional Head of PR & Communications, this individual will support the coordination and execution of day-to-day communications activities, collaborate with external agencies and internal stakeholders, and help ensure the timely delivery of regional initiatives. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional looking to develop practical experience in a fast-paced, international environment within the technology and digital finance industry.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Marketing, Journalism or a related field, either completed or in progress.
1–2 years of relevant experience, with previous internships or entry-level experience in PR, communications, marketing, influencer management or event coordination considered an advantage.
Previous exposure to PR/communications agencies or the technology, fintech or digital finance sectors is preferred but not mandatory.
Fluency in English is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.
Good organizational and time-management skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks.
Proactive, resourceful and eager to learn, with a collaborative and hands-on attitude.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, multicultural environment and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
Familiarity with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, particularly Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.
Interest in technology, digital finance, media and emerging industry trends is an advantage.
Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy
Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

r: PR & agency coordination: Support day-to-day coordination with regional PR agencies, track deliverables, maintain activity trackers and follow up on deadlines and ongoing projects.

d: Majid Al Futtaim Holding is the leading shopping mall, retail, communities, entertainment developer and operator in the Middle East, North Africa, and Central Asia regions. With over 43,000 people, revenues of over US$ 11 Billion, and operations in 18 countries. Some of the iconic brands we carry include Mall of the Emirates, Carrefour, All Saints, Lego, City Center, Abercrombie & Fitch, & Vox Cinemas. We believe in making Great Moments for Everyone, Every day.
Customer Service Coordinator | MAF Properties | Oman Cluster

The position is responsible for supporting overall execution and delivery of the bespoke Customer Service program in a specific MAF Mall. Mainly responsible for the day-to-day smooth operations of the Customer Service Information Desk, ensuring that all customer service-related activities are carried out in accordance with the process and procedures, and the services provided are of the highest-level standards to ensure effortless, unforgettable, and sensorial customer experience.
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of mall assets, services, layouts, stores, and promotions to ensure smooth Customer Service desk operations.
Ensure efficient daily operations of the Customer Service Information Desk in line with established policies, procedures, and management guidance.
Deliver exceptional customer service by assisting with inquiries, directions, promotions, calls, and assigned mall services while maintaining a professional, courteous attitude.
Handle and resolve customer complaints across all channels professionally within SLA, escalating issues when required.
Coordinate closely with tenants, retailers, and internal departments (security, maintenance, etc.) to ensure smooth operations and issue resolution.
Manage customer services and programs such as gift cards, loyalty programs, valet, stroller/wheelchair rentals, gift wrapping, lost & found, and other mall services.
Ensure accurate inventory control, proper payment handling, compliance with finance procedures, and reporting of discrepancies or shortages.
Uphold company image, grooming standards, code of conduct, and values; support marketing events, maintain mall appearance, tenant relations, directories, and provide required reports.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required
Minimum of 2+ years’ experience in the Customer Service field.
Experience should be within a reputed shopping center or luxury hotel environment.
Experience may be gained within the GCC or internationally.
Strong customer-facing experience in a premium service environment is preferred.

d: KAIZEN Asset Management Services, a prominent property management firm in Dubai, is looking for a seasoned and detail-oriented Senior Facilities Engineer to enhance our team. In this role, you will leverage your extensive knowledge and experience in facility management to ensure the operational excellence of our properties, contributing significantly to tenant satisfaction and building performance.

As a Senior Facilities Engineer, you will oversee complex building systems and maintenance activities, implementing effective strategies for continuous improvement and cost efficiency. You will lead troubleshooting efforts, manage maintenance personnel, and ensure compliance with all applicable safety regulations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Facility Management, or a related field.
Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in facilities management, with a focus on engineering roles.
Proven experience overseeing building operations and maintenance, preferably in a senior capacity.
Strong technical expertise in building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire safety.
Excellent leadership and team management abilities.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with clients and maintenance staff.
Proficient in facility management software and Microsoft Office Suite.
Knowledge of health and safety regulations and compliance standards.
r: Manage and oversee the operation, maintenance, and repair of all building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and structural elements.
Conduct in-depth inspections and assessments to identify potential issues and develop solutions to enhance system performance and reduce downtime.
Lead and mentor the facilities team, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative environment.
Develop and maintain preventive and corrective maintenance programs to ensure all systems function optimally.
Coordinate with contractors and vendors for major repairs and renovations, ensuring all work meets the company's quality standards and budget constraints.
Prepare and manage the facilities budget, including estimating costs for repairs and upgrades.
Conduct energy audits and implement initiatives aimed at sustainability and energy efficiency.
Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, health and safety standards, and environmental policies.
Prepare detailed reports on facilities performance and project progress for presentation to management.
Stay updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in facility management.

To make everyone feel like the diamond they are! To build a global community of fragrance lovers through the power of scent and by providing them with the most innovative & luxurious fragrances, education and sharing our Middle Eastern fragrance rituals with the world.
